assets.name: banner-750x400.jpg
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Draw ONE landscape, full-bleed illustration for a WeChat sticker album detail-page banner at 750 × 400 (15:8), no layout or panels. Reference images 1 and 2 are the SAME established character from this sticker album: use their likeness, hair shape and colors, ornament placement, costume, face and thick organic dark doodle outlines faithfully. Qwen: periwinkle-blue long hair, thick side braid on the viewer's right, blue eyes, small tilted round blue-and-white hat on the viewer's left with a white-petaled blue-edged flower, golden drop earrings, white mandarin collar with blue and gold fasteners and blue sleeves. Blue folding fan. Match the lively hand-inked little chibi with broad opaque color blocks and a few crayon highlights in the references. No typography, readable letters, numbers, signatures or watermark anywhere. Scene: In a bright rose-and-jade waterside courtyard she snaps her cobalt folding fan open, sending three loose peach-blossom petals into a curling breeze above a turquoise pond. Willow boughs and a simple coral moon bridge make the breeze visible; the blue fan, face and turning petals form the main action. Luminous spring greens with a peach sky. Frame the single character large enough to recognize, with face, main prop and action fully inside the central 85% of the picture. Let background shapes fill all four sides. Give the image a rich colored opaque ground. Keep proportions natural, uncluttered silhouettes, one coherent moment, no white margin and no text.
assets.process: Proportional center crop to 750 × 400; JPEG quality 91, 4:4:4.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One square WeChat sticker album cover cutout, genuinely transparent RGBA outside the art. Reference images 1 and 2 are the SAME established character from this sticker album: use their likeness, hair shape and colors, ornament placement, costume, face and thick organic dark doodle outlines faithfully. Blue folding fan. Match the lively hand-inked little chibi with broad opaque color blocks and a few crayon highlights in the references. No typography, readable letters, numbers, signatures or watermark anywhere. Pose: a composed, friendly front-facing smile, blue folding fan partly open low across her chest so both face and collar remain visible, thick side braid visible. assets.process: Trim transparent margins using alpha ≥ 8 with two source pixels of padding, scale proportionally with Lanczos3, center on transparent canvas.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Design ONE dedicated WeChat chat-tray icon on a genuinely transparent square background, optimized to look recognizable at 50 × 50 pixels. Reference images 1 and 2 are the SAME established character from this sticker album: use their likeness, hair shape and colors, ornament placement, costume, face and thick organic dark doodle outlines faithfully. Draw only the character's HEAD from straight in front: small self-assured smile with open blue eyes; preserve tilted flower hat on viewer left and visible start of braided hair on viewer right; no fan.
